records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue increased by $14.6 million, or 9.7%, to $165.1 million for the three months ended April 1, 2022, from $150.6 million for the three months ended April 2, 2021, and our revenue increased by $25.7 million, or 8.6%, to $324.8 million for the six months ended April 1, 2022, from $299.1 million for the six months ended April 2, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Given the significant continued economic uncertainty and volatility created by the pandemic, it is difficult to predict the nature and extent of impacts on the demand for our products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, cash used in operating assets and liabilities was $28.3 million for the six months ended April 1, 2022, primarily driven by an increase in accounts receivable of $16.0 million, an increase in inventories of $10.7 million and a decrease of $4.9 million in accrued and other liabilities.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 59.9% and 55.9% for the three months ended April 1, 2022 and April 2, 2021, respectively, and 59.5% and 55.0% for the six months ended April 1, 2022 and April 2, 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjustments to reconcile our net income to cash provided by operating activities primarily included a net gain of $114.9 million related to the sale of our equity method investment offset by equity method investment losses, depreciation and intangible amortization expense of $29.1 million and share-based compensation expense of $19.9 million.
